title: Tax Planning Knowledge Diffusion via the Labor Market
eligible_reason: No specification satisfies the rules. The main design (Tables 1, 4-9, online appendix) is a movement-level stacked event panel: each tax-employee hire (movement_id, 1,083 hires at 448 firms, event years -3..+2) is a stack, the regressor formeragg_post = formeragg x post compares hires from tax-aggressive former firms with hires from non-aggressive former firms, and fixed effects are movement_id + eventyear (relative time) + SIC2 x fiscal-year, with 14 time-varying firm controls ($controls_etr) in every column. There are no calendar-time unit FE and all units experience a hire, so this is not a staggered binary-adoption TWFE. Table 3 (firm-year panel, 2,408 firms, 1995-2018) uses A_Hire, which is a short-window indicator (377 firm-years, 131 firms, switches back to zero for 120 of them), and its firm+year FE column includes the time-varying controls; the no-controls column is a stacked regression (group_id x gvkey, group_id x fyear FE, 17 stacks), which is excluded; the eventdd event study absorbs only SIC2.
design_notes: Datasets: movements.dta (6,175 firm-years around 1,083 hires), panel.dta (24,180 firm-years), stacked.dta (124,931 rows, 17 stacks), movements_extended4-8.dta (longer post windows for Table 5), departures.dta (Table 9), pairing.dta (Table 2). Treatment construction (01_table1_figure1.do lines 28-52): formeragg = 1 if the former firm's 5-year cash ETR minus the SIC2-size-year mean AND minus the year mean are both in the bottom quartile; formeragg_post = formeragg * post. Globals: $fe = movement_id eventyear sic2fyear; $cluster = gvkey; $controls_etr = roa1 fi1 size1 lev1 mtb1 salesgrowth1 ppe1 intangible1 rd1 advert1 special1 extraordinary1 nol_dummy1 delta_nol1. Table 3: reg/reghdfe cash_etr1 A_Hire [$controls_etr_panel] with no FE, SIC2+year FE, firm+year FE; eventdd cash_etr1, timevar(event3) method(hdfe, absorb(sic2)) leads(4) lags(3); stacked: reghdfe cash_etr1 A_Hire, a(group_id#gvkey group_id#fyear) cluster(gvkey#group_id) with and without controls. Table 4 alternative aggressiveness cutoffs and pweight wgt1; Tables 6-8 subsample splits and triple interactions (formeragg_post##focal_group); Table 9 departing-firm placebo.
estimators_reported: stacked_event_did_with_controls (movement FE + event-year FE + industry-year FE)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Hire years in panel.dta span 1998-2015 (18 distinct first-A_Hire years among 131 firms); not relevant for eligibility because A_Hire is non-absorbing and every FE column with firm+year FE carries time-varying controls.

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked movement-level design with relative-time (eventyear) FE instead of calendar-time FE; time-varying controls in every column; comparison group is other hiring events, not untreated units
specs.reported_location: Table 4 column 1 (also Table 1 sample, Table 5 column 1)

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls ($controls_etr_panel) in the firm+year FE column; A_Hire switches off (window indicator)
specs.treatment_definition: indicator for firm-years following the hire of a tax employee from an aggressive firm within a limited window (377 of 24,180 firm-years; reverts to 0 for 120 of 131 firms)
specs.controls: $controls_etr_panel (roa1 fi1 ls_win lev1 mtb1 salesgrowth1 ppe1 intangible1 rd1 advert1 special1 extraordinary1 nol_dummy1 delta_nol1)
specs.notes: Near-miss: dropping the controls would give a TWFE on a non-absorbing window treatment.

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked design (group_id x gvkey and group_id x fyear FE)

specs.treatment_var: event3 relative-time dummies (leads 4, lags 3, accumulated endpoints, baseline -1)

data_files_note: All derived analysis datasets (panel, stacked, movements, movements_extended4-8, departures, pairing; Stata .dta) are shipped; raw LinkedIn resumes and raw Compustat/CRSP are omitted but the constructed variables are included, so every do-file can be run.
screener_notes: Accounting-style stacked hire-event design. Even if one re-cast Table 3 as a firm-year TWFE, A_Hire is a window indicator that turns off and the no-control version only exists in stacked form. Record as not eligible; near-miss noted for Table 3 columns 4-5.
